map.口令强度按 7 项加 1：长度≥8、≥12、含小写、含大写、含数字、含符号；得分: Password strength scores 7 items with 1 point each: length ≥8, ≥12, contains lowercase, contains uppercase, contains digits, contains symbols; score ≤2 is weak, ≤4 is medium, otherwise strong. Generated passwords default to 16 characters from a character set with confusing characters removed:
map.忘记主密码能找回吗？: Can I recover it if I forget the master password?
map.不能。主密码不存储明文，忘记将无法解密保管库；请牢记或妥善保存加密备份文件。: No. The master password is not stored in plaintext, so forgetting it means the vault cannot be decrypted; remember it carefully or keep the encrypted backup file safely.
map.本地加密保管账号密码，主密码锁定解锁，支持显示/隐藏密码、一键复制、密码强度检测: Store account passwords with local encryption, locked and unlocked by master password, supporting show/hide password, one-click copy, password strength checking, random password generation, and encrypted backup export and import. Data stays local only.
map.一键复制账号密码: One-click copy of account and password
map.如：绑定邮箱、安全问题等: e.g. bound email, security questions, etc.
map.本地混淆存储账号口令（教学演示），点击右上角可锁定。所有数据仅保存在本浏览器。: Stores account passwords locally with obfuscation (teaching demo); click the top-right to lock. All data stays in this browser.
map.首次使用请设置主密码，用于本地加密保管口令。主密码无法找回，请务必牢记。设置主密: Set a master password on first use for local encrypted password storage. It cannot be recovered, so keep it safe. The vault is encrypted locally with PBKDF2-SHA-256 (200,000 iterations) + AES-256-GCM; the master password is never stored in plaintext. For high-value accounts, still use a professional password manager and two-factor authentication.
map.本工具采用 PBKDF2-SHA-256（20 万次）+ AES-256-GCM: This tool uses PBKDF2-SHA-256 (200,000 iterations) + AES-256-GCM local encryption with random salt and authentication; professional password managers are still advised for high-value accounts.
map.保管库已用 AES-256-GCM 加密，请输入主密码解锁。: The vault is encrypted with AES-256-GCM; enter the master password to unlock.
map.本地 AES-256-GCM 加密存储账号口令，点击右上角可锁定。所有数据仅保存: Stores account passwords locally with AES-256-GCM encryption; click the top-right to lock. All data stays in this browser and the master password is never uploaded.
map.加密为随机 16B 盐 + PBKDF2-SHA-256（20 万次）派生 25: Encryption uses a random 16-byte salt and PBKDF2-SHA-256 (200,000 iterations) to derive a 256-bit key, then AES-GCM authenticated encryption with a random 12-byte IV; salt and IV are stored with the ciphertext.
map.解密需同一主密码重新派生密钥；错误密码或密文被篡改时 GCM 认证失败，不会解出: Decryption requires the same master password to re-derive the key; a wrong password or tampered ciphertext fails GCM authentication and never overwrites the original vault.
map.采用带认证的 AES-256-GCM 与慢哈希派生，能抵抗离线篡改；安全性仍取决: It uses authenticated AES-256-GCM with slow key derivation, resisting offline tampering; security still depends on master-password strength and device safety. High-value accounts should use a professional password manager with two-factor authentication.
